progress.title: Your progress
progress.intro: What you have actually done: study time, quiz results and the topics you marked as understood.
progress.privacyNote: Only you can see this page.
progress.emptyState: Nothing to show yet. Log a study session or take a quiz and it will appear here.

week.heading: This week
week.activeDays: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} with study this week
week.activeRule: A day counts when you logged at least 10 minutes or took a quiz. Opening the site does not count, and missing a day costs nothing.
week.plannedVsMeasured: Planned this week: {planned} min. Logged with the timer: {measured} min. Plans and timers measure different things, so treat the gap as information, not a grade.

chart.heading: Minutes per day, last {days} days
chart.alt: Bar chart of minutes studied per day over the last {days} days, {total} minutes in total. A table with the same numbers follows.

coverage.heading: Syllabus coverage
coverage.basis: Measured against {stage}, using your topic ratings and quiz answers.
coverage.estimate: estimate {estimate} (likely {low} to {high}, from {count, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}})
coverage.note: “Not enough data” means nothing has been measured for this {subject} topic yet, which is different from doing badly. “Understood” is your own mark and is shown separately from the estimate.

review.title: Missed questions
review.intro: Every quiz question you got wrong, so you can try it again.
review.practiceNote: Retrying is practice: it can resolve a miss, but it does not change your plan or your mastery estimate.
review.emptyNoMisses: No missed questions yet. When you get a quiz question wrong it will show up here.
review.unknownTopic: Topic not linked to the syllabus
review.retryWrong: Not quite. The correct answer is marked below.
review.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

timer.title: Study timer
timer.intro: Work in focus blocks with short breaks. Only focus time counts as study time.
timer.subject: Subject (optional)
timer.focusComplete: Focus block complete. Take a break when you are ready.
timer.breakComplete: Break over. Start the next block when you are ready.
timer.elapsedFocus: {minutes} min of focus so far in this session
timer.guestNote: You are not signed in, so nothing is saved: the timer works, but sessions are not logged.
timer.signInToLog: Log in to keep a study log.
timer.savedGuest: Nice work: {minutes} min of focus. Log in if you want sessions saved.
timer.tooShort: That session was under a minute, so it was not saved.

errors.unauthenticated: Please log in to save sessions.
errors.too_short: A session must be at least one minute.
errors.too_long: A session can be at most 12 hours.
errors.in_future: A session cannot be in the future.
errors.too_old: A session cannot be more than a year old.
errors.invalid_topic: That topic does not belong to that subject.
errors.invalid_plan_item: That plan item is not available.
errors.overlap: This overlaps another session you already logged.

manual.heading: Log time studied away from the timer
manual.hint: For a lecture or a problem set on paper. It follows the same rules as the timer.
